game.name: Zelda3 DS
game.desc: Native port of the reimplementation of The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past (snesrev/zelda3), adapted to dual-screen handhelds running ROCKNIX. The top screen shows the game; the bottom screen shows the world map, dungeon map, touch inventory and settings. Requires zelda3_assets.dat generated from your own US ROM.
